itinerary_text: Morning: Depart Interlaken for Jungfraujoch via cogwheel railway (2hrs). Visit Sphinx Observatory, Ice Palace and Aletsch Glacier viewpoint at Top of Europe (3,454m). Afternoon: Return to Interlaken, take scenic boat cruise on Lake Brienz. Visit Giessbach Falls. Evening: Return to Interlaken hotel.

activity_combination: Lucerne City Tour + Mount Pilatus Golden Round Trip
itinerary_text: Morning: Walk through Lucerne Old Town, visit Chapel Bridge (Kapellbrücke) and Lion Monument. Take boat from Lucerne to Alpnachstad. Afternoon: Ascend Mt. Pilatus by steepest cogwheel railway in the world. Enjoy panoramic views at 2,128m summit. Descend by gondola and cable car to Kriens. Bus back to Lucerne.

activity_combination: Rhine Falls + Stein am Rhein + Zurich Old Town
itinerary_text: Morning: Drive from Zurich to Rhine Falls (Rheinfall), Europe's largest waterfall. Take boat ride to the central rock. Visit Stein am Rhein medieval town with painted facades. Afternoon: Return to Zurich, walking tour of Old Town (Altstadt), Bahnhofstrasse shopping, Lindenhof viewpoint. Evening: Free time at Zurich Lake promenade.
